name: homebutler
description: homebutler tells you what changed on your servers since the last time it looked, and only what is worth telling: a container recreated, an image changed, a port answered by something new. A single Go binary with a web dashboard, CLI and MCP server, no database, and no agent or daemon on the machines it watches.

notes.text: The dashboard's API needs the token generated at install: web.token in /root/.config/homebutler/config.yaml.

Inside this container homebutler sees the container, not the Proxmox host. Add the node under proxmox: in the config with a read-only API token to see the host and its guests, and other machines under servers: over SSH. See https://github.com/Higangssh/homebutler/blob/main/docs/proxmox.md
